title: From Monoliths to Pharmacists-at-Scale: Patient-Aware Multi-Agent Reasoning Tames Million-Dimensional Discovery

contributions.purpose: 把药物协同发现重构为患者感知的闭环 RL 搜索
contributions.mechanism: 三角色多智能体(Synergy Scout / Dose Adapter / Safety Sentinel)+ 分布式 DQN + 优先经验回放 + 课程扩展(500→3994 对),PK/PD 约束嵌入奖励
contributions.evaluation: 1.04M 药-患组合上 val R2=0.913、test RMSE=0.041、AUROC=0.955、可行剂量 97.3%、新组合命中 34/100
contributions.domain: 药物协同预测 / 多智能体强化学习
contributions.source_quote: We introduce a patient-aware, reinforcement-learning-augmented multi-agent system that re-imagines discovery as an active, closed-loop search over both drug pairs and individual pharmacology.

contributions.purpose: 宣称大幅超越单体与静态 MAS 基线
contributions.mechanism: 对 DeepSynergy/PharmAgent/MatchMaker/DeepSynergy-MARL 及自身消融对比
contributions.evaluation: 722% efficacy gain(Table 3:自系统 6.084 vs 他者 0.74–0.85)、AUROC 0.955 vs 0.875、消融去 MARL R2 降到 0.740 且不可行剂量 31.4%
contributions.source_quote: a validation R² of 0.913 and an 83.2% accuracy on literature-validated pairs, translating to a 722% efficacy gain over DeepSynergy and a 15% AUROC lift over the best prior multi-agent framework.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our contribution is not another static MAS. We fuse (i) MARL-guided combinatorial search with curriculum expansion, (ii) patient-specific PK/PD constraints inside the reward, and (iii) online fine-tuning of every agent via exponential moving averages.
